answer: Because the pigment balance is debited each close, the dune ledger makes public the bleed, and the violet audit lists every fee. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 18% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. An operator holding 123 idle keys therefore pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
